newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low.

text.p: London palladium fixed at a fresh three-year low of $119.50 an ounce on Friday, equal to the fixing on September 16, 1993.
Palladium had fixed at $120.50 in the morning, but has come under pressure from recent weakness in silver.
London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low =2
Dealers said a convincing break below the key $120 support level would likely signal further losses. Important support was not expected to emerge until the $112-$115 area.
Palladium, which is used in the automotive and electronics industries and in dentistry, has been losing ground in recent weeks on slack investor and industrial demand.
Its sister metal platinum has also slid lower and was fixed at $387.25 an ounce, equal to the recent low fix on July 4, 1996.
